# FAIAS - Financial AI Independent Assurance Standard

> FAIAS is a baseline for reviewing generative, agentic and predictive AI systems in financial institutions.

Version 1.3.6. Manifest root 02a6117b48752898bbe04c5e7e6d08f1c87307e725641be36462e5e03a9714d0. Signed 20 November 2026.

This file is a derived copy made from the signed FAIAS text. The signed text is each file at its `url`, and its sha256 is in the signed manifest.

A signature shows that a file has not changed since the owner signed it. It says nothing about whether the text is correct, or about a firm that uses FAIAS.

A reader that did not calculate the sha256 of a file has not verified that file. It can state only which version and manifest root the file names.

The public key is in the same repository as the text. So a check with that key shows only that the files agree with each other. A comparison of the key with a copy held elsewhere, for example in the Zenodo record, shows that it is the owner's key.

Lines quoted from the standard:

- "FAIAS is not a certification or approval scheme: no one is authorised to certify, accredit or approve anything against it." (README.md, line 113)
- "The reviewer never tests production systems" (README.md, line 11)
- "★1 is a statement about the field, never a reason to skip." (00_Admin/ASSURANCE_MODEL.md, line 185)
- "The ★ rating in each canvas carries its anchor inside the rating artefact" (00_Admin/ASSURANCE_MODEL.md, line 195)
- "integrity — the content has not changed since signing — and authorship control" (ownership/OWNERSHIP_PROOF.md, line 91)
- "The signature binds content to a key, not to a moment in time." (ownership/OWNERSHIP_PROOF.md, line 93)
- "No test is rated ★4 or ★5." (ownership/ATTESTATION.txt, line 6)
- "An opinion at any tier is given at limited assurance." (ownership/ATTESTATION.txt, line 6)
